DISCOVERY 610, DAVID HYSINGER APPEARING FOR DEFENDANT. NO OTHER APPEARANCE. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED: DEFENDANT'S MOTION TO COMPEL RESPONSES TO FORM INTERROGATORIES AND ATTENDANCE AT DEPOSITION IS GRANTED. PLAINTIFF IS ORDERED TO SERVE COMPLETE VERIFIED RESPONSES WITHOUT OBJECTION WITHIN 14 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. THE COURT FURTHER ORDERS THAT PLAINTIFF CONTACT COUNSEL FOR DEFENDANT TO SCHEDULE HIS DEPOSITION WITHIN 14 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. THE DEPOSITION IS TO BE COMPLETED ON OR BEFORE DECEMBER 30, 2004. FAILURE TO RESPOND WAS A MISUSE OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. SANCTIONS ARE AWARDED IN THE AMOUNT OF $336.30, TO BE PAID WITHIN 14 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. COMM: BRUCE E. CHAN
